How it works

Set it up once.
Then it runs.

  1. 01

    Answer a few questions.

    Your age, sex, height and weight, how many days you want to train, how you like to eat, the foods you like and more. All of it goes into a plan built just for you, in seconds.

    Your body, your week, the food you like.

  2. 02

    Coast decides.

    A week of meals that lands on your macros every day, and the shopping list for it. A training program with exactly the sets, rest and effort each muscle needs. When to bulk and when to cut.

    Your meals, your training, when to cut and when to bulk.

  3. 03

    Cook once. Train. Live.

    Every aspect is built to be as efficient as possible, so you reach your body goals without spending more time than you need to. Then go back to living.

    Reach your goal without it taking over your life.

The meals

One cook. 10 minutes.
Ready for the week.

Every day is planned to your protein target, and on a cut that target goes up, as the research recommends. The batch meals are cooked once for 8 tubs, mostly in a slow cooker with 10 minutes or less of hands-on work, so hitting your protein is the easy part of the week.

Where the rules come from

Research,
not opinions.

42 sources behind the 25 decisions the app makes about your route, your training and your food. Where the evidence is thin, it says so.

Training · Good

How many sets.

A muscle's hard sets each week. Pelland et al. 2026, meta-regression of 67 studies.

 Your route · Strong

How fast to cut.

Losing fat without losing muscle. Garthe et al. 2011, a trial in 24 elite athletes.

 Meals · Good

How much protein.

Grams a day, and more on a cut. Morton et al. 2018, meta-analysis of 49 studies.

 Training · Estimate

When to back off.

A lighter week before fatigue piles up. Bell et al. 2023, 2025, expert consensus, few trials.

 Your route · Estimate

How big, drug-free.

Where natural muscle tops out. Kouri et al. 1995, FFMI in 157 athletes.

FAQ

Common questions.

How do I keep muscle while losing weight?
Three things the research agrees on: enough protein, strength training, and not cutting too fast. Coast plans all three: your protein target, a program that keeps you lifting, and a pace of about 0.5% of your body weight a week.
How much protein do I need?
It depends on your weight and your goal, and it is higher on a cut. The app works it out from published studies and plans every day to hit it. The studies are on the research page.
I've never lifted. Will the training work for me?
Yes. Pick 1 to 6 days a week and train at a gym, at home or with bodyweight only. Every exercise shows how to do it, and the program tells you how hard to push on every set.
Do I need a slow cooker?
For 29 of the 37 batch meals, yes. The other 8 are oven bakes. Any 5.5 L slow cooker works: this one is $24 at Big W. Not sponsored, no commission.
Won't I get sick of eating the same thing?
One cook covers different meals across the week, not one dish seven times. Swap any meal for another you like and the app re-balances the day so it still lands on your macros.
How much does Coast cost?
Coast is free: meal plans, training programs, shopping lists and meal prep, with no ads and no account.
